component.name: agentglass
component.summary: Every AI coding agent on your machine, on one screen

description.p: agentglass watches the AI coding agents already running on your machine and puts them on one screen: live cost, token use and tool calls across every provider, with a hold on anything dangerous until you say go.
It supervises the agent CLIs you have installed rather than replacing them, so Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity keep working exactly as they did.

This Flatpak is packaging, not confinement. Supervising the tools on your machine means reaching them, so it is granted host filesystem access and permission to run host processes. Anything it can do, it can do outside the sandbox.
